name: FinRL-Meta
description: Finance is a particularly difficult playground for deep reinforcement learning. However, establishing high-quality market environments and benchmarks for financial reinforcement learning is challenging due to three major factors, namely, low signal-to-noise ratio of financial data, survivorship bias of historical data, and model overfitting in the backtesting stage. In this paper, we present an openly accessible FinRL-Meta library that has been actively maintained by the AI4Finance community. First, following a DataOps paradigm, we will provide hundreds of market environments through an automatic pipeline that collects dynamic datasets from real-world markets and processes them into gym-style market environments. Second, we reproduce popular papers as stepping stones for users to design new trading strategies. We also deploy the library on cloud platforms so that users can visualize their own results and assess the relative performance via community-wise competitions. Third, FinRL-Meta provides tens of Jupyter/Python demos organized into a curriculum and a documentation website to serve the rapidly growing community. FinRL-Meta is available at: https://github.com/AI4Finance-Foundation/FinRL-Meta
evaluation_method: returns-based evaluation (cumulative return and risk-adjusted metrics such as Sharpe ratio, max drawdown)
general_score_metric: cumulative_return (with risk-adjusted metrics like Sharpe ratio)
reputation: Actively maintained open-source library by the AI4Finance community and used as a common starting point for financial RL research and demos.
notes: Provides many simulated/real historical market environments; susceptible to survivorship bias, backtest overfitting, data leakage and non-stationarity; results are highly environment- and strategy-dependent; non-LLM benchmark.
